transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. Well, I suppose what made me come in is that my eating has just gotten all turned around lately. Some days I completely forget to eat lunch. And then other days, I'll find myself just standing at the kitchen counter eating crackers and sweets... even though nothing really tastes right to me anymore.
Beyond the changes in your eating, have you been feeling persistently sad, down, or hopeless lately?
Yes, I suppose I have. Most mornings I wake up with this... well, this heavy, low feeling. It's just like the color has gone out of the day before I even get dressed.
Have you ever felt this way during any other periods in your life, or is this the first time you have experienced these symptoms?

Well... no, I don't think so. I mean, I've had my normal ups and downs over the years, of course. But this heavy feeling that just sits with me every morning... no, I don't recall ever going through a patch quite like this before. I'm pretty sure this is the first time it's been this bad.
When you find yourself eating those snacks, are you doing so because you are preoccupied with your body shape or weight?

Oh, no, not at all. It has nothing to do with my weight or my shape. At my age, I'm not really worrying about my figure anymore. 

It's just... well, they're just sitting there on the counter, and they're easy to grab. I'm really just eating them without thinking much about it at all.
Are there any activities or hobbies that you used to enjoy that you no longer find pleasurable or interesting?

Yes, actually. I used to really look forward to my watercolor class, and the quilting circle, and... well, my book club too. But lately, I just pack my bag and leave it sitting by the door. I just can't seem to make myself care enough to actually go anymore. It's just too much effort.
When you are feeling this way, do you find that you are moving or speaking much more slowly than usual, to the point where others might have noticed it?

Yes, I suppose I have. My body just feels... slowed down lately. It's like it takes me twice as long just to walk across the room or even button my sweater in the morning. 

But then, it's a bit strange, because other times I do the opposite. I'll find myself just pacing around the house, walking back and forth with the same stack of papers in my hand for no real reason. So I guess my movements have been a bit off lately, yes.
Have you been experiencing any strange or unusual thoughts, or hearing or seeing things that others do not seem to notice?

Well, I haven't been hearing or seeing things, no. But I have had some... unusual thoughts, I suppose. 

I know it sounds odd to say out loud, but I keep feeling that certain dates and names in our family papers are being changed. Or maybe hidden from me. It just seems like the hospital, or maybe someone in the family, is trying to send me little messages through the records. I just keep looking at them and feeling like they've been altered somehow.
Do you feel that these family records are being altered because you are being punished for something, or because you believe you are somehow responsible for the family's misfortunes?

No, I don't think it's a punishment. And I don't feel like I caused any of the bad things that have happened to the family. It's just... I just feel like someone is changing the records. I don't really know why they're doing it, or what the messages mean. I just know that things look different than they should.
Do you feel that these messages are meant specifically for you, or that you are the only one who can understand their hidden meaning?

Well, yes, I suppose I do. Like I was saying a moment ago about the dates and names being changed in our family papers... it feels very deliberate. I don't think anyone else would even notice that they've been altered or hidden. 

It just really feels like whoever is doing it—whether it's the hospital or someone in my family—is slipping those little messages in there specifically for me to find. I haven't completely figured out what the hidden meaning is myself yet, but... yes, they definitely feel like they are directed right at me.
